Package com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.timeline

Class Timeline

java.lang.Object
com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.timeline.Timeline
public class Timeline extends Object
Timeline object created from a Timelined object which contains organized list of frames and their contents.

JPEXS
